Markus,

Hope you're well. As part of GreenArc's DPA review and procurement checklist we're doing a quick rollcall of all third-party processors that will touch GreenArc data (both telemetry and any customer payload). Can you send: 

- A current list of Redwood's processing suppliers (name, service provided, country(ies) of processing, whether they hold or can access plaintext customer payload, and primary contact)
- Any planned changes in the next 90 days (onboarding, decommissions) and expected dates
- A short note about cross-border handoffs (which regions data flows through) and any mitigations (KMS jurisdiction, encryption-in-transit, access controls)
- If there are planned changes to the roster that require a DPA amendment, please include the draft or a link so our legal team can assess impact.

We are asking for this because procurement needs an evidence package and signoff by 2027-08-20 to meet our go-live window. If you can share the manifest and a single-page timeline by EOD Friday that would be ideal. If needed we can set a 30-minute call to walk through.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

Best,
Daria Cole
Head of Security
GreenArc Systems
